query: What happens when Google Pixel 3a XL buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: Defective phone!. They sold me a defective phone. I sent it back and they still have not refunded any of my money. Almost 400 dollars!
Seller is sending locked phones.. Phone was not unlocked. Seems to be a common issue with this seller.

Defective screen... Phone looks fine from outside and came with a 3rd party charger. Did not come with a sim removal tool. The phone has a defective screen, one can clearly see multiple vertical black strips in the backgroud. Seller offered me a $15 partial refund for a defective screen if i want to keep the phone... what a joke and waste of time.

Phone had problems kept crashing. I have had this phone in the past and is no doubt a great phone all around but the one from this seller had major issues and would keep crashing every 10 seconds , very disappointed I really wanted to go back to using this phone for a little while until I could afford the new pixel. I would not buy from this seller

Buyer Beware!!!!! 20% to 50% restocking fee if returned!!!!. Perfect condition and really cute but I didn't notice it was locked to Verizon. I could not use. ****Update****Buyer Beware... this listing showed up in a search for unlocked phones so I mistakenly bought it but it was locked to Verizon. I returned it because I was unable to use it and was charged a 20% restocking fee and a charge to mail back. I am fine with the charge to mail back but the restocking fee was ridiculous and not noted when I ordered. I have had to return items before for various reasons and never lost this much money as a result. I am very unhappy with this merchant and do not recommend.

The seller did offer to cover shipping to return the phone but why false advertize your product? Upon informing the seller their phones were not unlock, they changed the listing but I now listed again as "unlocked". If you don't mind the legwork in getting the phone unlocked then this can be a good cost savings, but be aware of that going into the purchase.
Phone not unlocked!!. I bought the phone and it's not unlocked. I can't use my fi service here. Straight scam. I need a refund or a new phone that actually works.

Broke in weeks. I have had many Google Pixel phones for myself and family. This one was by far the worst. I had to toss it and buy a Pixel 4 from another seller. I got zero support from the seller who refurbished the device. Likely an issue with the seller more than the device it's self.

Phones do not work. I originally purchased a refurbished phone to replace a previous pixel I had broken and received it and while attempting to set up the phone found out it had been stolen and locked down by Verizon. I contacted amazon and they sent a replacement that did not register there was a SIM card. Suffice to say I will be keeping far away from Amazon’a refurbished phones.

Like new! Make sure you look at seller ratings.. I was pretty nervous about ordering a renewed phone from Amazon because of all the mixed reviews. I learned that Amazon lists these phones from multiple refurbishers, and you are able to see the ratings of each one before you buy it. I went with "bayshine Trading" and bought 2 Pixel 3a XL's, both of which were like-new with no scratches on the screen and hardly any visible signs of use on the back. The battery also lasts the entire day with no issues. Don't just go with the cheapest seller, make sure you check out the seller ratings. Even if you aren't satisfied, you still have a 90 day return window.

phone started smoking out of the charging port.. What did I like? How cheap the phone was. What I didn't like? When it started smoking out of the charging port exactly one month and eleven days after purchase. Maybe, just maybe, if someone's selling refurbs that begin smoking out of the charging port after one month and eleven days, they shouldn't be selling refurbs at all. It's a good thing I was awake whilst it was charging - don't want to think about what may have happened if I charged the phone while asleep (what a lot of people do) tl;dr bought a new phone, received a repurposed bomb.

Listen to the reviews.... The phone was absolutely gorgeous. It would have been perfect if it were not locked to Verizon. I was extremely disappointed, I was expecting it to work on T-Mobile because I asked the seller after I made the purchase. He confirmed that it would work. Please do not waste your time and money on this particular seller. Find another more trustworthy seller, this one is a complete scam.

4 days out of 90 day warranty and no help.. I got the phone on apr. 2nd and literally only 4 days out of the 90 days warranty the charging port has failed. I would expect better from tech companies as i work for a tech company also. I contacted amazon services to see if they could help and since its out was a big NO. So i will have to get fixed myself because the product failed 4 days out of warranty i am livid. WOULD NOT BUY AGAIN!

EXCEPTIONAL customer support! (Hybrid IT). Note: This review is SOLELY for the phone and service by Hybrid IT, the seller. (You can pick your seller! Pick wisely!) Unlocking phones is more an art than science, and it's easy to miss something if you don't actually start the activation process with your preferred carrier. Well, that happened with my initial order of the Google Pixel 3A XL. I posted on Hybrid IT's page about it and within 5 minutes, they were on the phone with me. 10 minutes after that, they had verified that the replacement unit they were going to send me would clear activation on my service (they read the IMEI number to me over the phone and I checked), and they sent it FedEx next day. They also paid for the return shipping to their facility which I just sent out about 30 minutes ago. This level of service is OUTSTANDING.

Was sent the wrong phone!. We waited for this phone and were eagerly ready to get it all ready to use as soon as we received it. We bought a screen protector, a case, a pop socket, and a car mount for it. Well then we received the phone, opened it, and prepared to put the screen protector on it... and it didn't fit. I suspected that it was the wrong generation and after we did some research, it was indeed the 3 instead of the 3a XL. We are very disappointed and we will not buy from this company again as it is obvious they do not have very good quality control. Buyer beware!

Another lock phone from this seller!. Unfortunately, I was burnt like everybody else. This phone was not unlocked and a waste of time. This phone came from Verizon still locked. Price was right phone was wrong! I don't know why the seller is insisting that his phones are unlocked when they're not.

I reached out to customer service and the seller. Customer service did not stand by their product as stated. And not only that they cannot guarantee me a replacement that will actually work. I just wasted a whole lot of money that I was scared of using in the first place but like I said Amazon said it would be fine. It's not.
Phone was stolen. Returned. Phone was stolen. Returned.

Total scam. Phone not unlocked.. This phone was not unlocked and after calling the phone carrier attached to the phone they said it was possibly stolen from their warehouse. They could not unlock this phone. This seller is a scam.
Phone is locked to Verizon. Phone is locked to Verizon. So buyer beware. Had to return as there is no way to unlock a Verizon locked phone.
